items.problem: `bind_text` and `unbind_text` (localization-core.md:33-34, 127) do not set the result for an element that is null, already freed, or not a UI text element (e.g. a Godot `TextureRect`; the Godot rules list text nodes only for text scale, godot.md:403). There is no `## error` row for it, so one implementation can crash on a freed object, another ignore it silently, another leave an error log
